newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia allots 375 mln dinars for water works - paper.
newsitem.headline: Serbia allots 375 mln dinars for water works - paper.

text.p: The Serbian government will set aside 375 million dinars ($66 million) from its 1997 budget for building, reconstruction and maintenance of water works, Belgrade daily Politika Ekspres reported Monday.

Most of the funds, or 226 million dinars, will be directed into capital investment projects, while 97 million is earmarked for maintenance and rehabilitation of worn out systems for protection against floods and ice, the paper said.
Around 27 million dinars is reserved for elaboration of studies and projects and for international cooperation.

Due to extreme difficulties with water supply, around 92 million dinars from the investment programme will be used to build 140 water supply facilities, of which 63 are to be completed by the end of the year, Politika Ekspres said.
